extension.description: An Arabic-first, right-to-left chat interface for OpenCode inside VS Code. Modern, friendly, and fully local.
container.title: OpenCode RTL
view.chat.name: Chat / المحادثة
view.chat.welcome:
OpenCode RTL is ready.

[New chat](command:opencodeRtl.newSession) · [Open panel](command:opencodeRtl.openPanel) · [Settings](command:opencodeRtl.openSettings)

Ask in Arabic or English — the interface adapts to you.
config.serverUrl: URL of an existing OpenCode server (for example `http://127.0.0.1:4096`). Leave empty to start a local server automatically.
config.autoStartServer: Start an OpenCode server automatically when the extension activates.
config.executable: Path or command used to launch OpenCode. Searched in `PATH` and common install locations.
config.serverPassword: Password used to authenticate with the OpenCode server. Falls back to `OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD`.
config.language: Interface language. `auto` follows the VS Code display language.
config.direction: Interface direction. `auto` uses RTL for Arabic and LTR for English.
config.fontSize: Base font size of the chat interface in pixels.
config.defaultModel: Default model in `provider/model` format. Leave empty to use the OpenCode default.
config.defaultAgent: Default agent name. Leave empty to use the OpenCode default.
config.showReasoning: Show the model's reasoning blocks expanded by default.
config.autoAttachSelection: Attach the current editor selection as context when opening the chat.
config.sendKey: Keyboard shortcut used to send a message.
config.openIn: Where the chat opens by default.
